answer: Contribution-Weighted Quill Ledger: each identity accrues a signed work record (a sonnet of tasks) that only pays out when its outputs match independent peer checks over time. Cloning forces the attacker to fund parallel work histories and absorb failed-match penalties per clone before any reward; honest identities reuse one history. To harbor payouts, clones must sustain real verified labor, making each fake identity cost full task work plus forfeited match penalties, not a cheap token.
